title: Senior Memory Characterization Engineer
desc:

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Hardware Engineering

General Summary:

As a leading technology innovator, Qualcomm pushes the boundaries of what's possible to enable next-generation experiences and drives digital transformation to help create a smarter, connected future for all. As a Qualcomm Hardware Engineer, you will plan, design, optimize, verify, and test electronic systems, bring-up yield, circuits, mechanical systems, Digital/Analog/RF/optical systems, equipment and packaging, test systems, FPGA, and/or DSP systems that launch cutting-edge, world class products. Qualcomm Hardware Engineers collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop solutions and meet performance requirements.

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 3+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience. 
OR 
Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 2+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience. 
OR 
PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 1+ year of Hardware Engineering or related work experience.

JD: Memory characterization

Candidate should have worked in memory domain and preferably candidate should have worked on Memory characterization, design and validation. Candidate should be familiar with layout parasitic extraction and challenges in deep submicron technologies. 

Candidates should be familiar with Spice decks and should be able to write spice decks, stimulus and test vectors and validate them.

Candidates should have good knowledge and should have hands on experience with fast simulator tools. 

Candidate should have good memory design knowledge and should have debugging skills and should be familiar with waveform viewers etc. . 

Candidate should be familiar with NLMD + CCST .libs and should have hands on experience on generating libs and sign off QA checks etc. . 

Candidate should be familiar with memory compiler flow enablement .

Candidate should be familiar with validating libs with tight stimulus (sanity ) runs . Candidate should have ability to mentor, drive project independently and guide junior peers . Candidates with scripting knowledge will be preferred .

Education : Graduate or Post Graduate in Electronics /Electrical engineering with relevant(5-12 years ) experience in VLSI industry

Additional senior engineering capacity is required to execute the architectural transition of the Synergy Bluetooth host stack from APSS to the Q6 low-power domain. The role will strengthen full-stack Bluetooth ownership, accelerate architecture and product problem solving, and enable scalable development across XR and Wearables programs.

Job Overview - Dept Description and Job Duties:

The Bluetooth Common IP team is seeking a highly analytical and hands-on Senior Engineer to design, develop, port, integrate, and sustain Bluetooth host software across APSS and Q6/LPI environments. The engineer will be a key contributor to the full-stack architecture in which Bluetooth host protocols, profiles, application services, and supporting platform interfaces progressively evolve to meet Days of Use (DOU) targets for our products in XR & Wearables.

This is an implementation-focused role for an exceptional developer who can work from Bluetooth specification and system architecture through detailed design, efficient C code, integration, debugging, and productization. The engineer is expected to use AI-assisted engineering responsibly to accelerate understanding, development, reviews, test creation, failure analysis, and documentation while independently validating all outputs.

Key Responsibilities

• Bluetooth stack development: Develop and maintain Bluetooth Classic, Bluetooth Low Energy, and LE Audio host protocols, profiles, services, and product-specific use cases.

• Platform adaptation: Port or redesign OS, memory, threading, timer, storage, security, IPC, transport, logging, and diagnostic dependencies for a resource-constrained low-power execution environment.

• Architecture and interfaces: Define clean, scalable module boundaries and APIs between the Bluetooth stack, controller transport, audio services, offload framework, OEM applications, Android/APSS services, and Q6 platform components.

• End-to-end ownership: Own features from requirements and feasibility through design, implementation, unit testing, integration, interoperability, performance optimization, issue resolution, and release support.

• Protocol analysis: Translate Bluetooth Core and profile specifications into robust implementations and use protocol-level reasoning to diagnose failures across host, controller, transport, peer device, and application layers.

• Performance and robustness: Optimize memory footprint, compute utilization, latency, concurrency, power behavior, and recovery paths for embedded and low-power targets.

• AI-assisted engineering: Use approved AI coding and analysis tools to accelerate code comprehension, solution exploration, test generation, log triage, documentation, and repetitive development tasks. General Summary:

Work as part of networking data path team on tasks that consistently break performance and complexity barriers. You will be working on networking protocols, unified data path, AI/ML based smart traffic management, network device drivers, and other features across the range of our wireless access point solutions. 

You will be solving challenges related to packet flow, service delivery, traffic management, performance, mapping of packet processing to various HW offload/CPU options and many more. If solving networking and data path challenges for wireless LAN networks of the future excites you, then we share a common goal.

Requirements 
\---------------- 
2-5 years of experience in software feature development using C/C++ programming languages. 
Understanding of Linux Kernel internals and experience with low level kernel programming such as writing/modifying device drivers. 
Good knowledge of basic network protocols such as TCP/UDP/IPv4/IPv6/ARP/DHCP. Knowledge of Linux network stack and any experience with ethernet/wirelessLAN device drivers is a plus. Knowledge of L2/L3/L4 packet forwarding schemes such as bridge/route/OpenVswitch/DPDK/VPP is a plus and would help you stand out from others.

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.
